rows.text: It's dusk, and you're standing amid the heat waves. The atmosphere at the mines makes you dizzy, the mineral veins burning like melted butter.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Great Qlipoth, Aeon of Preservation... THEY can hear our voices." The miners raise and dip their shovels like frenzied animals — or the faithful.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Someone notices you — It's the "lead miner" wearing a detector lamp. His arms are dark and muscular, and his lips are in a similar shade of ink. His hearty smile is very memorable. He has a gold tooth that ceaselessly expands and twists in your brain, till all you can see is his "smile" — His lips and eyes fuse together, like the melting sludge of paint on a palette.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Qlipoth, the blessing of the Amber Lord, preserves these leylines. You can have one of them."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Obtain one Enhanced 2-star Blessing of Preservation.
Fight with the lead miner and grab the stuff!
Enter 1 battle. Obtain 2 random Blessings of Destruction.
